changes.previous_text: A menu-based example from Café Prückel totals €51 for three meals, coffee and two sodas. That is one café example, not a daily Vienna food budget. Check paid palace and museum visits separately.
changes.replacement_text: Café Prückel lists breakfast dishes and coffee separately; include drinks when budgeting a meal. For Belvedere, choose Upper or Lower Belvedere before buying admission.

changes.previous_text: Our Dishoom menu example totalled £55 before optional service, or about £62 including the 12.5% optional charge and rounding. It is one restaurant example, not a daily London food budget.
changes.replacement_text: Dishoom Covent Garden has separate breakfast and all-day menus. Its service charge is optional and can be removed on request. Budget for your chosen dishes and drinks, not a citywide daily allowance.

changes.previous_text: Check admission for Westminster Abbey and other paid visits separately.
changes.replacement_text: Westminster Abbey recommends booking sightseeing tickets ahead. Sundays are for services, so choose another day for sightseeing and check the Abbey’s calendar before planning your visit.

changes.previous_text: Compare bakery or café breakfasts, simple takeaway lunches and casual dinners using current menus. The sampled Chartier menu is indicative and changes daily; it cannot establish a daily food budget.
changes.replacement_text: Bouillon Chartier’s sample menu is indicative and changes daily with deliveries. Use it to understand the dishes, not to set a daily Paris food budget.

changes.previous_text: Check Louvre admission and Eiffel Tower ascent tickets separately.
changes.replacement_text: Book the Louvre and Eiffel Tower separately. The Louvre recommends a time slot, including for free admission. For the tower, choose the second floor or summit and stairs or lift before budgeting.

changes.previous_text: Combine Gaudí’s designed spaces with a park outing. Check current works and ticket arrangements before deciding which parts to visit.
changes.replacement_text: Plan a dated, timed visit to Park Güell’s Gaudí-designed spaces and gardens. The operator recommends booking online ahead. Read its access notices before setting off.

changes.previous_text: Museu Picasso closes on Mondays. MNAC normally does too, with public-holiday exceptions. Move the museum day if needed and check your chosen date.
changes.replacement_text: Museu Picasso closes on Mondays. MNAC also closes on Mondays except public holidays. Check each museum’s calendar before choosing your museum day.

changes.previous_text: Topkapı Palace normally closes on Tuesdays. Swap the palace day with another outing when needed, and check holiday exceptions before booking.
changes.replacement_text: Topkapı Palace lists Tuesday as its weekly closing day. Put the palace on another day and consult National Palaces’ holiday schedule before arranging your visit.
